ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Figure 10 is a domestic route map of the ancient "Silk Road". Read the map and answer. <image1> When traveling along the ancient "Silk Road", one should pay attention to preventing wind and sand, ____.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure shows the domestic route of the ancient "Silk Road" within the outline of our country; the route extends from the central-eastern part toward the northwest, passes through the Hexi Corridor of Gansu, near Dunhuang, and enters Xinjiang; the areas along the route are mainly located in the inland northwest region of our country. Then reason: the question stem requires completing "When traveling along the ancient 'Silk Road', one should pay attention to preventing wind and sand, ____". The inland northwest region has an arid climate, little precipitation, many sunny days, and relatively strong solar radiation; when traveling, besides preventing wind and sand, one should also pay attention to preventing strong sunlight exposure, that is, preventing sun exposure. Therefore the blank should be filled with "sun exposure".
